cards.caption_en: Breakfast is ready: bread, butter, cheese, an egg, and milk.
cards.caption_zh: 早餐准备好了：面包、黄油、奶酪、鸡蛋和牛奶。
cards.image_prompt: Refined photorealistic Korean cool Instagram editorial photograph, vertical 4:5. Stylish East Asian adult woman around 25, ivory knit, loose low bun, natural skin texture and subtle high-end retouch, real hands and fabrics. Cool soft daylight, pearl white mist grey slate palette, clear teaching objects with real proportions, modest blank space for later annotation. No words, numbers, labels, logos, watermark or UI. Elegant kitchen, elevated three-quarter view. Woman preparing breakfast behind pale stone counter. Five DISTINCT separated items in foreground: sliced bread on wood board at left, rectangular pale yellow butter on tiny white dish center-left, triangular cheese wedge with holes on separate dish center-right, ONE whole brown egg in ceramic egg cup at right, glass of white milk at rear-right. Large readable objects, no packages, no clutter, food texture crisp. Woman gently arranging bread, all items visible.

words.example: The bread is on the board.
words.evidence: 左侧切片面包
小碟上矩形黄油

words.example: The cheese is on a plate.
words.evidence: 有孔三角奶酪

words.example: The egg is in an egg cup.
words.evidence: 棕色整蛋，不含蛋杯

words.example: I have a glass of milk.
words.evidence: 杯中白色牛奶，饮品身份由早餐设定说明
bread是food的具体可见实例；框对应的面包区域。
桌上已摆放的早餐食物组合区域；meal指这组早餐，ready由原创叙述说明准备完成，不把单件餐具当作一餐。
桌上已摆放的早餐食物组合区域；meal指这组早餐，ready由原创叙述说明准备完成，不把单件餐具当作一餐。
have breakfast用餐含义，不解释为拥有

cards.caption_en: I cook soup in the pot, with rice and potatoes beside me.
cards.caption_zh: 我用锅煮汤，米饭和土豆放在旁边。
cards.image_prompt: Refined photorealistic Korean cool Instagram editorial photograph, vertical 4:5. Stylish East Asian adult woman around 25, ivory knit, loose low bun, natural skin texture and subtle high-end retouch, real hands and fabrics. Cool soft daylight, pearl white mist grey slate palette, clear teaching objects with real proportions, modest blank space for later annotation. No words, numbers, labels, logos, watermark or UI. Elegant kitchen stove, camera elevated enough to see inside ONE open steel pot. Woman stirring pale vegetable soup with wooden ladle, no lid obstructing. Visible small bubbles on soup surface and faint realistic rising white steam, not smoke. Two whole brown potatoes on separate board at right foreground; bowl of cooked white rice left foreground. Pot handles distinct, coherent cooking action, kitchen and upper body visible.

words.evidence: 手持勺子在锅内搅拌的烹饪动作

words.example: The pot is on the stove.
words.evidence: 锅身与把手，不含整座炉台

words.example: The soup is in the pot.
words.evidence: 锅中可见液体汤面

words.example: A potato is on the board.
words.evidence: 旁边一颗完整棕色土豆

words.example: The rice is in a bowl.
words.evidence: 碗中白色熟米饭，不含整只碗
锅内汤面及气泡的区域；boiling采用原创烹饪设定与例句，区域定位所指汤面，不从照片测量温度。
锅上方可见白色水汽区域，不当烟雾
热量不可见，由烹饪设定和句子说明
手持木勺在锅中搅拌制作汤的动作区域，make soup指向这个制作活动。

cards.caption_zh: 我摆好盘子、叉子和勺子，然后切黄瓜。

words.evidence: 白色餐盘整体
独立金属叉子

words.example: I hold the knife by its handle.
words.evidence: 切黄瓜的厨刀整体

words.example: The spoon is beside the plate.
words.evidence: 椭圆勺头与勺柄

words.example: The tray is on the table.
words.evidence: 右侧有边沿的木托盘，不混同砧板
切菜用途与句子说明锋利，静态图不测试锋利度

words.example: The edge of the knife cuts food.
words.evidence: 刀片与黄瓜接触的切削边缘
手、刀与黄瓜接触的切割动作区域

words.example: The blade is made of steel.
words.evidence: 只定位金属刀片，不含刀柄

cards.caption_en: I give you a cup of warm tea with sugar.
cards.caption_zh: 我递给你一杯加糖的温茶。
cards.image_prompt: Refined photorealistic Korean cool Instagram editorial photograph, vertical 4:5. Stylish East Asian adult woman around 25, ivory knit, loose low bun, natural skin texture and subtle high-end retouch, real hands and fabrics. Cool soft daylight, pearl white mist grey slate palette, clear teaching objects with real proportions, modest blank space for later annotation. No words, numbers, labels, logos, watermark or UI. Elegant apartment kitchen, TWO distinct East Asian adults. Main woman at left offers ONE small white ceramic CUP of tea by its handle, recipient adult woman at right in pale slate shirt accepts supporting cup underneath. Cup fully visible between coherent hands, no duplicated cup or fingers. Counter foreground has one unbranded steel stovetop KETTLE with spout and handle left, an OPEN clear glass sugar bowl with visible white sugar granules at right. words.evidence: 两人之间的白色杯子

words.example: The kettle is on the counter.
words.evidence: 有壶嘴和提手的金属烧水壶

words.example: The sugar is in the bowl.
words.evidence: 开放玻璃碗中的白色颗粒，糖的身份由原创设定说明

words.example: The tea is sweet with sugar.
words.evidence: 味觉由句子说明，不声称照片测得甜度
温度由设定说明，少量水汽不证明具体温度
drink为名词饮品，定位双方手中盛茶的杯子；茶的内容由原创设定说明。

words.example: I give you a cup of tea.
words.evidence: 两人手部与同一杯茶的递交接取区域；give与take由原创句子分别说明递出者与接收者，不框人物全身。
两人手部与同一杯茶的递交接取区域；give与take由原创句子分别说明递出者与接收者，不框人物全身。
高亮for，说明接受者，不设框
高亮with，说明饮品配料，不设框

cards.caption_en: I choose red, yellow, and green apples at the fruit stall.
cards.caption_zh: 我在水果摊挑选红色、黄色和绿色的苹果。
cards.image_prompt: Refined photorealistic Korean cool Instagram editorial photograph, vertical 4:5. Stylish East Asian adult woman around 25, ivory knit, loose low bun, natural skin texture and subtle high-end retouch, real hands and fabrics. Cool soft daylight, pearl white mist grey slate palette, clear teaching objects with real proportions, modest blank space for later annotation. No words, numbers, labels, logos, watermark or UI. words.evidence: 主人公手里红苹果
右侧篮子里一颗橙子，采用水果义

words.example: A blueberry is a small berry.
words.evidence: 前景蓝莓中的一颗，泛称berry由例句明确
fruit的可见实例为手中的苹果，采用同一实际苹果区域，不框整个摊位。
前景托盘上一颗带壳核桃

words.example: The apple in my hand is red.
words.translation: 我手里的苹果是红色的。
words.evidence: 手中实际红苹果的区域，red描述这只苹果的颜色。

words.example: The apples in the middle are yellow.
words.evidence: 前景中间篮子中黄色苹果的区域，yellow描述这些苹果的可见颜色。
前景右中篮子中绿色苹果的区域，green描述这些苹果的可见颜色。
